Acme Corp Reports Record Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2014 Results

SPRINGFIELD, Jan. 2, 2015 -- Acme Corp (NYSE: ACME) today announced results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2014. Revenue for the quarter was $120 million, an increase of 12 percent compared with the same period of the prior year, driven by strong demand for the company's industrial products and the contribution of its recent acquisitions.

"We are pleased with the performance of the business in the quarter," said the chief executive officer. "Our teams continued to execute on our strategy, and we enter the new year with a strong backlog and a healthy balance sheet that will allow us to invest in growth."

The company also announced that its board of directors has approved a quarterly dividend of $0.10 per share, which will be paid on February 15, 2015 to shareholders of record at the close of business on February 1, 2015.
